verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.doola.com that returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the Partner API and its workflows (EIN signatures, prioritized EIN, name-rejection handling). doola also publishes an agent-oriented skill.md, and its docs pages are served as raw .md files (e.g., authentication.md, webhooks.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at them. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, since every candidate OpenAPI path returned 404.
